visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two people, a female in an orange polo shirt and a male in a black t-shirt and apron, stand in a commercial kitchen/shop setting. They are positioned behind a counter with large bags of garlic and red plastic basins. (2) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands vigorously rubbing and peeling a whole head of garlic over a red basin. (3) The male character, wearing a black cap and apron, is seen from the chest up, focused on manually peeling garlic cloves. (4) A top-down shot shows dark sauce being poured from a metal container into small white condiment bowls arranged on a tray. (5) Another close-up focuses on hands intricately peeling the thin skin off individual small garlic cloves. (6) The male character holds up a single, perfectly peeled garlic clove to the camera, gesturing with his other hand. (7) A group of four people, all wearing similar black aprons or orange shirts, are gathered around a table, collectively peeling garlic into red basins. (8) A man in a blue apron and black cap suggests a new method while holding a clear plastic bottle. (9) A close-up shows a person vigorously shaking the clear plastic bottle filled with garlic cloves in a high-energy motion. (10) The garlic is poured out of the bottle into a red basin, but most of the skins are still attached. (11) The male character looks at the bottle and then the camera with a disappointed expression. (12) A shot of garlic being peeled is followed by the male character's face turning grayscale with a sweat-drop emoji overlay. (13) Hands are shown putting garlic into a glass bowl of warm water and then peeling them easily. (14) The male character makes an 'X' symbol with his arms in a grayscale frame. (15) The group of four is shown again, continuing their manual peeling task while large informational text overlays appear.

(6) [Slogan]: 無限7秒輪迴. [Variety]: (好安靜的剝蒜). (7) [Subtitle]: 快速剝蒜的方法. (8) [Slogan]: 寶特瓶剝蒜法. [Subtitle]: 將大蒜放進寶特瓶裡 搖晃30秒 大蒜就可以輕鬆脫皮. (9) [Variety]: 好!!. (10) [Variety]: 成功了嗎?. (11) [Variety]: 網路謊言. (12) [Variety]: 究竟. (13) [Variety]: 好像沒有喔. (14) [Slogan]: 溫水剝蒜法. [Subtitle]: 將大蒜放進溫水浸泡後 就可以輕鬆脫皮. (15) [Variety]: 網路謊言again. (16) [Slogan]: 歡迎網友們跟我們分享 更多有用的剝蒜方法. [Variety]: (拜託不要再是網路謊言了).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, upbeat pop background music track begins immediately. A female voice speaks with a friendly, narrative tone about learning from an elder, while a male voice briefly interjects. (2) The music continues as the female and male voices discuss the traditional method of peeling garlic. A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound is heard. (3) The vocal track shifts to a more informative tone explaining sauce ingredients. Percussive electronic beats drive the rhythm. (4) The music suddenly stops, replaced by the synthesized sound of wind or crickets to emphasize the 'silence' of manual peeling. (5) An 'impact' sound effect plays as the male voice introduces a new method. (6) A loud, rhythmic percussive sound of garlic cloves rattling inside a plastic bottle dominates the track, synchronized with high-energy music. (7) A 'ding' sound and cheerful group shouting 'Successful?' occur. (8) The male voice returns with a slightly disappointed, comical inflection. (9) A dramatic orchestral drum hit followed by a classic canned laugh track plays to highlight a comedic failure. (10) The BGM shifts to a light, smooth texture as a new method is tried. (11) A loud buzzer 'wrong' sound effect and another laugh track play. (12) Upbeat closing music swells with energetic synthesizers and drum beats.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Test 1 -> Failure -> Test 2 -> Failure -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain the audience by testing popular 'life hacks' for peeling garlic in a restaurant setting. It uses a comedic 'expectation vs. reality' framework to show that these internet shortcuts often fail compared to traditional manual methods.
